cells.gaps: No share or count of primary clinics entering their own reports: the 100% (RWA-027) is a rollout statement for all 1,819 facilities with no numerator, resting on 13 facility visits, and RWA-002's 520 are health centres, under a third of the 1,763 health centres and health posts it lists. The newest tier fact (RWA-024, 2024-06) names no T4, and reporting completeness has been found only undated (RWA-011). No plan or finance fact falls inside the 36 months (RWA-020, plan:none, is dated 2021), so governance would cap a higher rung; nothing is held for the last twelve months.
cells.note: Reports are keyed into DHIS2 at the facility (RWA-026), but the 100% is a rollout to all facilities and the 520 are health centres only, while whether the 1,250 health posts key their own reports is not shown. Rung 4 needs a share or count of primary clinics alone (Bill, 2026-10-23), so the cell takes rung 3.

cells.gaps: No row establishes a unique patient identifier or a record retrievable at another facility, so `shared` is not met; the one digitised fact outside the excluded source (RWA-001, October 2026) has data recorded electronically from the moment a patient enters, with no facility count. The clinic figures disagree: 33.0% of sampled health centres using an EMR in 2023 (RWA-018), 'majority of public health facilities' with no figure in April 2026 (RWA-004), and 'more than two thirds of health centres' in September 2026 (RWA-021), which has no numerator, denominator or source and says where eBuzima is, not who enters data. T2 rests on the 2023 survey of all 42 district hospitals (RWA-019); T1 on one hospital. Rows RWA-007 to RWA-010 are from the excluded source and set nothing. Where the record is keyed is stated only by a fact dated after the as-at (RWA-001). Health posts are evidenced only for Society for Family Health Rwanda's own network, 126 of its 350 with the internet access eFiche needs (RWA-035, RWA-036, May 2026); the Global Fund puts national digital record coverage at 12% in 2024 (RWA-039), against the unsourced more-than-two-thirds.
cells.note: Stage 3 is met on all 42 district hospitals using an EMR in 2023 and health centres using one across the country; one partner's health posts now use eFiche. It is not 4 because the record is not shown to be shared across facilities and no sourced figure puts more than half of primary clinics on it.
cells.parent: Parent, 2026-10-07: RWA-001 is dated after the as-at and sets nothing; digitised left empty, which stage 3 does not turn on. Tiers set to T1;T2;T3: the district hospitals the stage rests on are T2.
